# Daily Report — 2026-09-26

## Task Completed
Added `bulk_update_request_items` tool: PATCH multiple sc_req_item (RITM) records in a
single Batch API call. RITM numbers are resolved to sys_ids with one preliminary GET before
the batch PATCH is issued. Supports all key sc_req_item fields:
short_description, description, state, stage, assigned_to, assignment_group,
work_notes, close_notes. Up to 100 items per call. Per-item item_id enriched in results.
Registered in service_desk, change_coordinator, and full packages.
